feature.name: Symbols
feature.what_it_does: Insert mathematical equations (with the Equation contextual tab) and special symbols not on the keyboard.
feature.behavior: Insert mathematical equations (with the Equation contextual tab) and special symbols not on the keyboard.

subfeatures.name: Equation
subfeatures.what_it_does: Inserts an empty math zone at the cursor (measured: OMaths 0→1) and activates the Equation contextual tab; the dropdown offers built-in equations (quadratic formula, area of circle…).
subfeatures.behavior: Opens Equation (dropdown) (dropdown). Contents (15 controls): Color swatches, Equation, Line up, Position, Area of Circle, Binomial Theorem, Expansion of a Sum, Page down, Fourier Series, Pythagorean Theorem, Line down, More Equations from Office.com, Insert New Equation, Ink Equation, Save Selection to Equation Gallery.... [flyout of subfeature:equation-insert-gallery — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule; sections: Built-In] Appears as a pi symbol, labelled 'Equation', with a chevron.

subfeatures.name: Symbol
subfeatures.what_it_does: Opens a gallery of recently used symbols plus More Symbols… (the full character map) to insert characters not on the keyboard.
subfeatures.behavior: Opens Symbol (dropdown). Contents (23 controls): Color swatches, Symbol, Euro Sign, Pound Sign, Yen Sign, Copyright Sign, Registered Sign, Trade Mark Sign, Plus-Minus Sign, Not Equal To, Less-Than Or Equal To, Greater-Than Or Equal To, Division Sign, Multiplication Sign, Infinity, Micro Sign. [flyout of subfeature:symbol-insert — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule] Appears as an omega symbol, labelled 'Symbol', with a chevron.
